summary: XAI Madison Equity Premium Income Fund filed an 8-K regarding the Board's unanimous approval, subject to shareholder vote, of PineBridge Investments as an additional sub-adviser to manage a preferred equity strategy alongside current sub-adviser Madison. The Fund's investment objective remains unchanged; allocation targets 20-30% preferred equity, 70-80% covered call equity. No transaction price, premium, or deal terms are involved. This is a routine management/adviser change requiring shareholder approval, not a special situation. The event is operational, and no risk-arb angle or advisory M&A exists.
